scripts.test: rm -rf mochawesome-report && mocha --parallel --jobs 7 --require mochawesome/register --node-option require=ts-node/register --node-option require=tsconfig-paths/register --require src/preflight.ts --recursive 'src/tests/**/*.ts' --timeout 90000 --slow 30000 --reporter mochawesome --exit; node scripts/check-test-results.mjs

scripts.test:no-node-service: rm -rf mochawesome-report && mocha --parallel --jobs 7 --require mochawesome/register --node-option require=ts-node/register --node-option require=tsconfig-paths/register --require src/preflight.ts --recursive 'src/tests/**/*.ts' --ignore 'src/tests/node-service/**' --timeout 90000 --slow 30000 --reporter mochawesome --exit; node scripts/check-test-results.mjs
